purpose: Independent second batch of ordinary single-page text questions over the documents already present in knowledge base 1
selectionPolicy: Keep the existing knowledge-base documents; do not upload, rebuild, or replace documents for this selection.
Do not reuse any source row from n5.3-normal-text20-selection.json.
Use only original public-dataset questions whose complete evidence is on one physical page.
Require evidence_sources to be exactly Pure-text (Plain-text).
Exclude questions involving tables, charts, figures, diagrams, visual styling, cross-page aggregation, or multi-step arithmetic.
Prefer ordinary factual, definitional, procedural, and list questions whose answer can be verified directly from prose or text lists.
Manually inspect the rendered evidence page before authorizing the paid Answer run.
